records.name: Grubenwart Tiefgenug
records.biography_en: Considers daylight an administrative rumour. His lantern divides HyperNorm tunnels into known and forbidden. A dissonant card illuminates an exit missing from both categories. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Tageslicht ist bislang nur vom Hörensagen bekannt.

records.name: Bohrknecht Förderlich
records.biography_en: Tightens every joint except the one in the official argument. His wrench tightens every HyperNorm joint marked negotiable. A dissonant card keeps finding pressure where the report promises none. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Verbindung hält mehr aus als die Begründung.

variant_notes.note_en: Tightens every joint except the one in the official argument.

records.name: Geologin Fundstelle
records.biography_en: Can find a deposit more easily than an agreed explanation of it. She scans a HyperNorm rock core that contains two apparently incompatible histories. Neither fits the approved sample tray. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Fund ist gesichert. Seine Deutung nicht.

variant_notes.note_en: Can find a deposit more easily than an agreed explanation of it.

records.name: Bohrmeister Druckhalt
records.biography_en: Keeps the pressure within limits while the limits keep moving. His valve admits either acceptable pressure or an incident. A dissonant card asks whether comfortable was ever considered. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Grenzwert wurde der Lage nachgeführt.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps the pressure within limits while the limits keep moving.

records.name: Asteroidenhauerin Splitterruh
records.biography_en: Finds solid work in a universe determined to remain mostly empty. She drills HyperNorm certainty from an asteroid officially classified as empty. A dissonant card has already made a home inside it. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Leere erwies sich als erstaunlich ergiebig.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds solid work in a universe determined to remain mostly empty.

records.name: Vakuumförderer Restdruck
records.biography_en: Collects the last drop before somebody changes the definition of a drop. His sealed HyperNorm sample keeps producing bubbles after its contents are declared settled. A dissonant card counts them as questions. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der letzte Tropfen hat weiteren Gesprächsbedarf.

variant_notes.note_en: Collects the last drop before somebody changes the definition of a drop.
